verdict.rationale: Claude documents explicit user controls to prevent training use: incognito chats are never used to improve Claude even with Model Improvement enabled, users can toggle the 'Model Improvement' privacy setting, and connector data (Gmail/Drive/Calendar) is explicitly excluded from training. This directly satisfies the ai-native privacy-posture story of preventing data from being used for model training. Missing for 10: independent/third-party verification of these claims and explicit default policy for Enterprise/Team plans beyond connectors.
